cast_dialogue.linea: Welcome to the Tournament of Adjectives, heroes! Who is taller? Who is the fastest of all? Let the battle begin.
London is bigger than Medellín, but Medellín is more beautiful!
My phone is more expensive than yours, but yours is better.
The cheetah is the fastest animal in the world, and the turtle is the slowest.
My soup is the best in the neighborhood. And dancing is the most exciting exercise of all!

banco_oraciones.oracion: My phone is more expensive than yours.
The cheetah is the fastest animal in the world.
Her soup is the best in the neighborhood.
English isn't more difficult than Spanish.
The turtle isn't faster than the cheetah.
This isn't the worst movie of the year.
Is your phone more expensive than mine?
Is English easier than Japanese? Yes, it is.
Is this the best restaurant? No, it isn't.
Is the cheetah faster than the turtle? Yes, it is.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: London is more big than Medellín.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Short adjectives take '-er/-est' (tall→taller→the tallest); long adjectives take 'more/the most' (beautiful→more beautiful→the most beautiful). Irregulars: good→better→best, bad→worse→worst. Compare with 'than'.

ejercicios.pregunta: The cheetah is ___ animal in the world.
Her soup is ___ in the neighborhood.

ejercicios.texto: This is ___ movie of the year. (bad)

ejercicios.respuesta: The turtle is slower than the cheetah.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: London is more big than Medellín.

ejercicios.respuesta: The cheetah is the fastest animal.

ejercicios.pregunta: Compare two things in your life. (Use a comparative with 'than'.)
ejercicios.respuesta: My house is smaller than my friend's house.

guion: Kenji: Let's compare! Which is faster, a car or a bike?
Ben: A car is faster than a bike, obviously.
Kenji: OK. And which is more expensive, your phone or mine?
Ben: Yours! But mine is better.
Kenji: Ha! Final question: what is the most beautiful city in the world?

comprension.pregunta: For Ben, what is the most beautiful city?

reading.texto: My friends love to compare everything. Ben says London is bigger than Medellín, but Sofía says Medellín is more beautiful. Kenji's phone is more expensive than Ben's, but Ben's is better. We all agree the cheetah is the fastest animal in the world and the turtle is the slowest. And Abuela Carmen's soup? It is the best in the neighborhood — that is a fact!

preguntas.afirmacion: Ben's phone is more expensive than Kenji's.
The turtle is the slowest animal.
